requirements.method: Select the same pattern/event and toggle VI to EN to VI.
requirements.expected: Pattern ID, event ID, event index, code lines and data values are unchanged; learner-facing title, purpose, prompts, feedback, invariant, controls and memory cue use the active locale.

requirements.method: Inspect computed accessible name in VI and EN.
requirements.expected: Every operable element has a unique, meaningful name in the active locale; Python identifiers may remain unchanged.

requirements.method: Traverse with Tab/Shift+Tab and activate with Enter/Space without pointer input.
requirements.expected: All interactive elements are reachable and operable in a logical task order, with no keyboard trap.

requirements.method: Inspect every keyboard focus stop in light and dark themes.
requirements.expected: A persistent outline or equivalent indicator is clearly visible and is not clipped.

requirements.method: Inspect event-zero, playing and final-event boundaries.
requirements.expected: Unavailable actions use native disabled or aria-disabled semantics, expose state without colour alone and do not mutate runtime state.

requirements.method: Inspect before and after Next, Previous, Reset, locale, change-input and Pause actions.
requirements.expected: A pre-existing polite, atomic live region emits one concise action result and current step where relevant; routine progress is not assertive.

requirements.method: Run Reset-to-final replay with prefers-reduced-motion reduce and no-preference.
requirements.expected: Both modes visit the same ordered event IDs and final state. Reduce disables decorative motion without skipping checkpoints.

requirements.method: Inspect current/changed/correct/incorrect/warning states in grayscale or high contrast.
requirements.expected: Text, icon, border/pattern, position or ARIA semantics retain every meaning when colour is unavailable.

requirements.method: Inspect role, heading and accessible-name relationships for every panel.
requirements.expected: Code, state, trace, output, invariant, prediction and feedback are identifiable regions or groups with visible headings and programmatic names.

requirements.method: Use a 320 by 800 viewport in VI and EN and traverse all controls/panels.
requirements.expected: No horizontal page scrolling, overlap or essential truncation; labelled code panels may scroll internally; controls remain at least visibly separable and operable.

requirements.method: At 320 px compare visual and DOM reading order.
requirements.expected: Core sequence is code, state/trace, output, prediction, feedback, controls; invariant and memory cue stay adjacent to the transition they explain.

requirements.method: Set desktop browser zoom to 200 percent and operate every control.
requirements.expected: Content reflows without lost text/control/focus indicator and ordinary content does not require two-dimensional scrolling.
A labelled bilingual before/delta/after explanation includes code locator, guard/invariant and does not present itself as an interactive trace.

requirements.method: Advance exactly one event and compare panel identity/current index.
requirements.expected: All panels render the same event and input revision; code highlight, state delta, trace/output and invariant describe one transition with no stale values.

requirements.method: Enter a prediction checkpoint from its preceding event while playback is active.
requirements.expected: Playback pauses and the prompt appears before target state/output and corrective feedback are disclosed.

requirements.method: Submit correct and incorrect predictions using keyboard only.
requirements.expected: Feedback names the relevant transition or invariant and a next action, uses non-colour correctness cues, and does not change event identity.

requirements.method: Inspect at event zero, a boundary event and final event in VI and EN.
requirements.expected: Cue is concise, meaning-equivalent across locales and tells the learner what to check or how to avoid losing a Paper 4 mark; it is more than a value restatement.

requirements.method: Advance, predict, then activate change input.
requirements.expected: Input revision is exposed, event resets to its documented start, stale feedback clears and all synchronized panels use the new revision.

gate_rule.result_owner: A8 or Lead independent of implementation owner
